_crawl.about: Headquartered in Dubai, Trychem operates out of the Jebel Ali Free Zone. Trychem offers its business partners a wide range of products and value added services such as filling services (bulk, IBC, drums, cans, bags), and mixing and blending, as well as technical support and services for various industries within the Life Science, Environmental and Material Science sectors. The company uses a bulk to bulk and bulk to break bulk distribution model where all bulk cargo is stored at the company's bulk storage facility with a combined capacity of 8500 cbm. Packed chemical products both in drums and bags are stored in warehouses which comply with stringent HSE international standards and are ISO and SQAS certified. As a distributor we are an important link between manufacturers and industrial users. Safety and sustainable business are our top priorities. We are part of the Brenntag Group, the global market leader in full-line chemical distribution, which provides global business-to-business distribution solutions for industrial and specialty chemicals by linking chemical manufacturers and chemical users. Brenntag offers one-stop-shop solutions to more than 170,000 customers. Headquartered in Mülheim an der Ruhr, Germany, the company operates a global network with more than 14.000 employees across 530 locations in more than 74 countries. In 2015 the company realized global sales of EUR 10.3 billion (USD 11.5 billion).

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make

# Culturelle® Medical Advisory Board


Our Microbiome Medical Advisory Board reflects our commitment to leveraging clinical evidence to
deliver microbiome-targeted solutions for your patients. Made up of trusted health care
professionals who truly understand the vital role the microbiome plays in overall wellness, the
Board helps guide our product innovation and clinical development with a focus on rigorous safety
standards and clinical efficacy. The Board is composed of health care professionals with extensive
clinical and research experience who provide strategic expertise across innovation, clinical
development, and medical education.

The Board supports the translation of emerging and established microbiome science into clinically
relevant solutions and contributes to the education of both health care providers and patients on
microbiome-targeted health solutions, with a focus on safety, scientific rigor, and clinical
relevance.

The Microbiome Medical Advisory Board is chaired by i-Health’s Global Scientific Engagement Leader,
Shavon Jackson-Michel, ND.

## Meet Our Board

#### Dr. Shavon Jackson-Michel

##### ND | Board Chair

Naturopathic Doctor and trained, biomedical engineer at the interface of product development,
clinical research and implementation science. Medical affairs and business development leader niched
in advancing researched, natural actives and botanical drugs across commercial pipelines and global
markets.

[ ** READ MORE ][22]

#### Dr. Vivian Asamoah

##### MD, FACG, IFMCP

John Hopkins fellowed and board-certified Gastroenterologist, Hepatologist and Nutrition expert.
IFM-certified Integrative Medicine practitioner. CEO of Houston Gastro Institute, practicing
physician, researcher, medical consultant, microbiome champion and educator. 

[ ** READ MORE ][23]

      

#### Dr. Jon Vanderhoof

##### MD

UCLA-fellowed Pediatric Gastroenterologist and researcher with 200+ publications. Chief of Pediatric
Gastroenterology at the Boystown NatResearch Center, attending at Boston Children’s and Senior
Lecturer at Harvard Medical School. Revered industry scientist, probiotics pioneer, and NASPGHAN
past president/awardee.

[ ** READ MORE ][24]

#### Dr. Whitney Casares

##### MD, MPH, FAAP

Stanford University and UC Berkely trained, board-certified Pediatrician and maternal and child
health Public Health specialist. A two-time American Academy of Pediatrics Author and Spokesperson,
private practice physician, consultant and educator. 

[ ** READ MORE ][25]

## Advisory Board Goals

#### Reinforced Credibility

Our brands have always held a credible standing – buoyed by our science and commitment to quality,
but this board will take this positioning to the next level, reinforcing and extending our reach not
only as a leader, but as an authority.

#### Expert Insights

Our Medical Advisory Board will provide key insights at a closer clip than ever! This fresh angle
will complement the advanced, metrics-driven, consumer-focused data that has always informed our
processes, innovations and positioning—supercharging our successes.

#### Thought Leadership

Holding brands with 20 and 30-year lifecycles, we know that success is a healthy combination of
courage, consistency and continuous evolution. Our boards boast 4x that in combined legacy &
experience, expanding the breadth of our excellence as an industry vanguard for decades to come.

The information on this site is intended for healthcare professionals in the United States and is
not intended for the general public.

Bionutricia is the pioneer in developing patented liposomal encapsulation technology in vitamin,
mineral, amino acid & nutraceutical/supplement formulation.

Liposomal delivery systems are highly effective for maximizing the absorption and bioavailability of
nutrients, vitamins, and active plant extracts.

Liposomes are a popular type of delivery system, particularly in the pharmaceutical and
nutraceutical supplement industries. They provide many advantages for consumers of nutritional
supplements.

## Advantages of liposomal

**Improved bioavailability**
Encapsulating active ingredients in liposomes helps to ensure they reach the inner body, since it
offers better dispersion and protection.

**Improved stability of the active ingredient in the body**
Liposome technology helps the active ingredient to be absorbed more easily in the intestine, and
stops it from breaking down too quickly. This helps the ingredient to stay stable, and gives it a
stronger effect.

**Enables advanced release**
The liposome has the unique ability to simultaneously absorb and release two materials with
different solubilities.

brands with dedicated service modules.

# Leading the Evolution of Speciality Oleo Chemicals

Fairchem leads the Indian speciality chemicals industry as one of the established Chemical Companies
in India and a trusted [Oleochemicals][14] Company in India. As a quality-driven Chemical
Manufacturing Company, we procure and refine by-products from vegetable oil refineries into valuable
ingredients used across high-value applications.

Recognized among progressive Specialty Chemical Companies in India, Fairchem contributes
significantly to the growing Oleochemical Industry in India by manufacturing performance-driven
Oleochemicals Products for nutraceutical, personal care, and industrial segments.

At Fairchem Organics Limited, we have built a dedicated platform to capitalize on the immense
opportunities within the Indian specialty chemical sector. Today, we are recognized among
progressive Chemical Companies in India and emerging leaders within the Oleochemical Industry in
India.

Our journey began with a vision to transform the industry, and today we stand as a trusted Chemical
Manufacturing Company delivering sustainable and value-driven solutions across industries.

[ Discover Our Impact ][15]

We have perfected a unique business model that revolves around procuring waste generated in
vegetable oil refining mills and converting it into high-value specialty ingredients. Through
advanced process technologies and operational excellence, we isolate and purify various components
that form the foundation of performance-driven Oleochemicals Products.

These include Isostearic Acid, Dimer Acid, Dimer Fatty Acid, and other specialty derivatives,
positioning us among reliable Oleochemicals Manufacturers in India and trusted Fatty Acid

printing inks and industrial formulations.

chemicals in India.

meticulously crafted for diverse industries. As one of the trusted Chemical Manufacturing Companies
in India, we deliver performance-driven solutions that support the growing Oleochemical Industry in
India and modern Nutraceuticals Manufacturing requirements.

Our commitment to excellence sets out the benchmark for innovation, sustainability, and product
reliability across specialty segments.

Recognized among reliable Natural Vitamin E Manufacturers and experienced Vitamin E Manufacturers in
India, Fairchem supplies refined tocopherol concentrates to global nutraceutical and wellness

performance across formulations.

As dependable Tocopherol Suppliers and a quality-driven Vitamin E Oil Manufacturer in India, we
support customers with sustainable, traceable, and regulatory-compliant solutions designed to

### About Us

Matrix Life Science is a global company based in India with sales offices in United States, Brazil
and Europe. With over 10 years of experience in the natural ingredients segment, we are one of the
leading manufacturers of natural antioxidants like Tocopherols & Rosemary extracts for food,
cosmetics & personal care, nutraceutical, pharmaceutical and animal nutrition.

#### [Vision][56]

Our vision is to create excellent quality products that combine green chemistry with technological
advancement and grow responsibly while striving to improve the quality of life in our society.

#### [Mission][57]

Our ambition drives us towards building a world-class company that challenges boundaries in the
nutraceutical sphere while also making healthier alternatives available for everyone. Our focus is
on delivering unsurpassed quality in all standards, using state-of-the-art production technologies
and maintaining a competent workforce. Through our industrial partnerships, we aim to create value
and complete customer satisfaction. Through our scientific ventures, we aim to set sail towards new
horizons for mankind.

## We don't bet on one model. We pick the best one for each step.

Luminix orchestrates Claude, Grok, and Gemini — using the one that's actually best at each part of
the job.

Gemini Google
Quick research for initial results

Gemini, with Google Search grounding, delivers trustworthy results fast for the opening analysis
phase — so you start seeing answers in seconds, not minutes.

Grok xAI
Most trustworthy research agents

Grok leads on web search and tops the public benchmarks for lowest hallucination rates of any
frontier model. That held true in our internal evaluations as well — which is why Grok runs the deep
research agents.

Claude Opus Anthropic
Final synthesis

Opus writes the long-form report. After comparing every frontier model on real synthesis runs, Opus
held the highest bar on long-form reasoning, structure, and not getting bored mid-document.

Model selections updated as frontier models change. The version above reflects the current
production stack.

## Research you can trust

### Multiple angles, one report

Your question explored is broken down into multiple research paths, including a 'cynic/challenger'
agent trying to understand any counterpoints.

### Sources throughout

Every claim traced back to where it came from, so you can dig deeper on anything that matters.

### Follow-up built in

Spotted something interesting? Ask follow-up questions that build on what's already been researched.

### Exportable analysis

Copy, share, or drop into docs. The output is yours to use however you need.

## For anyone with a hard question

### Evaluating a new market

You're considering expansion but need to understand the landscape—who's there, what's working, where
the gaps are. Get a comprehensive view without weeks of manual research.

### Tracking competitors

Something shifted in your market and you need to understand what a competitor is doing, how they're
positioning, what their customers are saying. Get the full picture, not just their homepage.

### Making a build vs. buy decision

You need to understand the vendor landscape, what solutions exist, how they compare, and what
building in-house would actually require. Get the research to make a confident call.

## Start with a real question

The best way to see if Luminix works for you is to try it with something you're actually trying to
figure out. Your first report is free.

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

# Culturelle® Medical Advisory Board


Our Microbiome Medical Advisory Board reflects our commitment to leveraging clinical evidence to
deliver microbiome-targeted solutions for your patients. Made up of trusted health care
professionals who truly understand the vital role the microbiome plays in overall wellness, the
Board helps guide our product innovation and clinical development with a focus on rigorous safety
standards and clinical efficacy. The Board is composed of health care professionals with extensive
clinical and research experience who provide strategic expertise across innovation, clinical
development, and medical education.

The Board supports the translation of emerging and established microbiome science into clinically
relevant solutions and contributes to the education of both health care providers and patients on
microbiome-targeted health solutions, with a focus on safety, scientific rigor, and clinical
relevance.

The Microbiome Medical Advisory Board is chaired by i-Health’s Global Scientific Engagement Leader,
Shavon Jackson-Michel, ND.

## Meet Our Board

#### Dr. Shavon Jackson-Michel

##### ND | Board Chair

Naturopathic Doctor and trained, biomedical engineer at the interface of product development,
clinical research and implementation science. Medical affairs and business development leader niched
in advancing researched, natural actives and botanical drugs across commercial pipelines and global
markets.

[ ** READ MORE ][22]

#### Dr. Vivian Asamoah

##### MD, FACG, IFMCP

John Hopkins fellowed and board-certified Gastroenterologist, Hepatologist and Nutrition expert.
IFM-certified Integrative Medicine practitioner. CEO of Houston Gastro Institute, practicing
physician, researcher, medical consultant, microbiome champion and educator. 

[ ** READ MORE ][23]

      

#### Dr. Jon Vanderhoof

##### MD

UCLA-fellowed Pediatric Gastroenterologist and researcher with 200+ publications. Chief of Pediatric
Gastroenterology at the Boystown NatResearch Center, attending at Boston Children’s and Senior
Lecturer at Harvard Medical School. Revered industry scientist, probiotics pioneer, and NASPGHAN
past president/awardee.

[ ** READ MORE ][24]

#### Dr. Whitney Casares

##### MD, MPH, FAAP

Stanford University and UC Berkely trained, board-certified Pediatrician and maternal and child
health Public Health specialist. A two-time American Academy of Pediatrics Author and Spokesperson,
private practice physician, consultant and educator. 

[ ** READ MORE ][25]

## Advisory Board Goals

#### Reinforced Credibility

Our brands have always held a credible standing – buoyed by our science and commitment to quality,
but this board will take this positioning to the next level, reinforcing and extending our reach not
only as a leader, but as an authority.

#### Expert Insights

Our Medical Advisory Board will provide key insights at a closer clip than ever! This fresh angle
will complement the advanced, metrics-driven, consumer-focused data that has always informed our
processes, innovations and positioning—supercharging our successes.

#### Thought Leadership

Holding brands with 20 and 30-year lifecycles, we know that success is a healthy combination of
courage, consistency and continuous evolution. Our boards boast 4x that in combined legacy &
experience, expanding the breadth of our excellence as an industry vanguard for decades to come.

#### Are you a healthcare Professional?

The information on this site is intended for healthcare professionals in the United States and is
not intended for the general public.

## Liposomal

Bionutricia is the pioneer in developing patented liposomal encapsulation technology in vitamin,
mineral, amino acid & nutraceutical/supplement formulation.

Liposomal delivery systems are highly effective for maximizing the absorption and bioavailability of
nutrients, vitamins, and active plant extracts.

Liposomes are a popular type of delivery system, particularly in the pharmaceutical and
nutraceutical supplement industries. They provide many advantages for consumers of nutritional
supplements.

## Advantages of liposomal

**Improved bioavailability**
Encapsulating active ingredients in liposomes helps to ensure they reach the inner body, since it
offers better dispersion and protection.

**Improved stability of the active ingredient in the body**
Liposome technology helps the active ingredient to be absorbed more easily in the intestine, and
stops it from breaking down too quickly. This helps the ingredient to stay stable, and gives it a
stronger effect.

**Enables advanced release**
The liposome has the unique ability to simultaneously absorb and release two materials with
different solubilities.

# Leading the Evolution of Speciality Oleo Chemicals

Fairchem leads the Indian speciality chemicals industry as one of the established Chemical Companies
in India and a trusted [Oleochemicals][14] Company in India. As a quality-driven Chemical
Manufacturing Company, we procure and refine by-products from vegetable oil refineries into valuable
ingredients used across high-value applications.

Recognized among progressive Specialty Chemical Companies in India, Fairchem contributes
significantly to the growing Oleochemical Industry in India by manufacturing performance-driven
Oleochemicals Products for nutraceutical, personal care, and industrial segments.

## About US

## Unveiling Fairchem

At Fairchem Organics Limited, we have built a dedicated platform to capitalize on the immense
opportunities within the Indian specialty chemical sector. Today, we are recognized among
progressive Chemical Companies in India and emerging leaders within the Oleochemical Industry in
India.

Our journey began with a vision to transform the industry, and today we stand as a trusted Chemical
Manufacturing Company delivering sustainable and value-driven solutions across industries.

[ Discover Our Impact ][15]

We have perfected a unique business model that revolves around procuring waste generated in
vegetable oil refining mills and converting it into high-value specialty ingredients. Through
advanced process technologies and operational excellence, we isolate and purify various components
that form the foundation of performance-driven Oleochemicals Products.

These include Isostearic Acid, Dimer Acid, Dimer Fatty Acid, and other specialty derivatives,
positioning us among reliable Oleochemicals Manufacturers in India and trusted Fatty Acid
Manufacturers in India. Our products serve diverse applications ranging from paints and coatings to
printing inks and industrial formulations.

Explore our journey, innovation capabilities, and commitment to shaping the future of specialty
chemicals in India.

## Explore Our Product Range

Explore our range of high-quality Oleochemicals Products and [nutraceutical][16] ingredients,
meticulously crafted for diverse industries. As one of the trusted Chemical Manufacturing Companies
in India, we deliver performance-driven solutions that support the growing Oleochemical Industry in
India and modern Nutraceuticals Manufacturing requirements.

Our commitment to excellence sets out the benchmark for innovation, sustainability, and product
reliability across specialty segments.

[ Discover Product ][17]

## Nutraceuticals

### The Power of Tocopherols

Our Mixed Tocopherols are a natural source of Vitamin E, a potent antioxidant known to support
wellness and slow down oxidative stress. As one of the trusted Tocopherol Manufacturers in India, we
specialize in producing high-quality Natural Vitamin E ingredients for diverse applications.

Recognized among reliable Natural Vitamin E Manufacturers and experienced Vitamin E Manufacturers in
India, Fairchem supplies refined tocopherol concentrates to global nutraceutical and wellness
brands. Our expertise in Nutraceuticals Manufacturing ensures consistent purity, stability, and
performance across formulations.

As dependable Tocopherol Suppliers and a quality-driven Vitamin E Oil Manufacturer in India, we
support customers with sustainable, traceable, and regulatory-compliant solutions designed to
enhance health-focused product development.

[ Learn More ][18]

derivatives. As a leading Oleochemicals Company in India, Fairchem transforms by-products of
vegetable oil refining into performance-driven Oleochemicals Products that support multiple
industries.

Derived from acid oil, our solutions include Dimer Fatty Acid, Isostearic Acid, and other specialty
materials, positioning us among reliable Oleochemicals Manufacturers in India and trusted Fatty Acid

Recognized within the evolving Oleochemical Industry in India, we are also dependable Fatty Acid

probiotics, amino acids, etc. We have: high-performance manufacturing capabilities, customized R&D

# Ibha Process Technologies Pvt. Ltd.

Ibha Process Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is one of the leading engineering and design firms dealing with
design, manufacture, and implementation of turnkey distillery and process plant. We have a history
in the industry dating back to more than 20 years and are determined to provide technologically
superior, energy efficient and affordable solutions to alcohol, ethanol and biofuel markets.

We have a broad portfolio of industrial working applications such as distilleries, pharmaceuticals,
agrochemicals, petrochemicals, food and beverage and Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) systems. Innovation
and engineering excellence are combined with us to provide fully customized, scalable, and compliant
solutions that address current as well as future process requirements.

Matrix Life Science is a global company based in India with sales offices in United States, Brazil
and Europe. With over 10 years of experience in the natural ingredients segment, we are one of the
leading manufacturers of natural antioxidants like Tocopherols & Rosemary extracts for food,
cosmetics & personal care, nutraceutical, pharmaceutical and animal nutrition.

Our vision is to create excellent quality products that combine green chemistry with technological
advancement and grow responsibly while striving to improve the quality of life in our society.

nutraceutical sphere while also making healthier alternatives available for everyone. Our focus is
on delivering unsurpassed quality in all standards, using state-of-the-art production technologies
and maintaining a competent workforce. Through our industrial partnerships, we aim to create value
and complete customer satisfaction. Through our scientific ventures, we aim to set sail towards new

## Navigate change. Decode demand. Grow with confidence.

Markets are changing faster than most planning cycles. Technology, regulation, supply chain shocks

Strategic Revenue Insights gives leaders a clear view of where demand is heading, how value pools

## Our Strategic Process

Luminix orchestrates Claude, Grok, and Gemini — using the one that's actually best at each part of

positioning, what their customers are saying. Get the full picture, not just their homepage.

building in-house would actually require. Get the research to make a confident call.
